contracts.signal: Correction filing for the semiconductor test equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics (original disclosure dated 06-29-2026 per the filing; order received 03-03-2026): the contract end date moves from 09-30-2026 to 12-31-2026 at the customer's request. Equipment worth about 79% of the contract amount has been delivered; the remaining about 21% is to be delivered by 12-31-2026. Amount KRW 40,300,000,000 (ex-VAT, non-conditional, 19.08% of 2024 consolidated revenue KRW 211,241,210,832), own production, Korea; payment 90% after delivery and 10% after set-up.
